controlScores.description: Ensure multifactor authentication is enabled for all users in administrative roles
Ensure multifactor authentication is enabled for all users
Enable Conditional Access policies to block legacy authentication
Ensure user risk policies are enabled
Ensure sign-in risk policies are enabled
Designate more than one Global Administrator
Set the password expiration policy to never expire
Do not allow users to grant consent to unreliable applications
Create Safe Links policies for email messages
Turn on Safe Attachments in block mode
Ensure all forms of mail forwarding are blocked and/or disabled
Turn on data loss prevention policies
Turn on Microsoft Defender Antivirus PUA protection in block mode
Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem
Turn on Microsoft Defender for Endpoint tamper protection
